verdict.rationale: Basecamp's Automatic Check-ins are a built-in recurring automation: the product asks the team questions on a schedule (e.g. every Monday at 9am) and collects the answers, which covers routine status-gathering work. That is a single, fixed type of scheduled action, not a general workflow builder. Templates are reusable but not scheduled, and the REST API is only a developer building block, so neither counts here. missing for 10: general configurable workflows with arbitrary actions, event-based triggers, recurring automations beyond check-in questions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create a workflow that runs on a schedule or recurring event to handle routine team work

citations.quote: Basecamp asks your team questions on a schedule, like “What are you working on this week?” every Monday at 9am, and saves everyone’s answers in one place.
Cut back on meetings by setting up Automatic Check-ins.
